panels.title: Poll / fire / fail / skip
panels.description: `skipped` is neither a success nor a failure: the coordinator dropped the turn without consuming the input (the conversation was IN_PROGRESS or AWAITING_HUMAN), so the schedule was re-armed at its next cadence with failCount untouched and will never dead-letter on skips alone. A skip line that tracks the fire line is a schedule whose message is being dropped every cycle while `failed` and `deadlettered` stay flat.

panels.title: Dead-lettered fires
panels.description: `eddi_schedule_fire_deadlettered_total` — retries exhausted; the trigger will not run again without intervention.

panels.title: Claim conflicts
panels.description: `eddi_schedule_claim_conflict_total` — two nodes raced for the same fire. A low rate is normal cluster behaviour; a high one means the poll interval is too tight.

panels.title: Retention sweeps — rows removed
panels.description: `eddi_schedule_firelog_pruned_total` — rows the retention sweep removed from the schedule fire log; flat while the table keeps growing means retention is off (`eddi.schedule.fire-log-retention=0`) or the sweep is failing — the poller logs that at ERROR. `eddi_logs_db_retention_deleted_total` — persisted log entries the daily sweep deleted; flat means `eddi.logs.db-retention-days` is off (the default) or the sweep is failing (logged at ERROR).

panels.title: Agent test runs / turns
panels.description: Agent regression test runs (golden conversations) by outcome, and the turns they execute. Runs drive real test-environment conversations: a sustained FAILED or ERROR rate is an agent version that no longer does what its suite says. Average run duration is sum/count of the run timer.

panels.title: Self-continuation
panels.description: `eddi_continuation_*` — turns an agent started itself with the reserved `CONTINUE_CONVERSATION` action. `scheduled` counts continuations armed after a committed turn, `run` the continuation turns that ran, `refused` the ones ignored or stopped, by reason: `disabled` (the agent sets no maxContinuations — usually a rule emitting the action on an agent that never opted in), `limit`, `cost_ceiling`, `not_settled`, `group_member`, `schedule_failed`, and at fire time `ended`, `awaiting_human`, `gone`, `restricted`, `undeployed` (retried), `interrupted`, `duplicate` (a re-delivered fire that found its turn already ran).

panels.title: Dream throughput
panels.description: `eddi_dream_*_total` — the DreamService consolidation pass. `conflicts skipped` counts prunes, overwrites and deletes Dream did not make because the memory was written after the cycle read it.

panels.title: Dream failures
panels.description: A failing cycle leaves memory unconsolidated; it does not lose data.

panels.title: Contradictions found
panels.description: `eddi_dream_contradictions_found_total` — conflicting memory entries detected.

panels.title: Summarization calls vs errors
panels.description: `eddi_summarization_calls_total` / `eddi_summarization_errors_total` — the shared summarizer used by both Dream and conversation windowing.

panels.title: Prompt snippet cache
panels.description: `eddi_snippets_cache_{hits,misses}_total` — Caffeine cache in `PromptSnippetService`.

panels.title: Integrations — MCP, A2A Identity, OpenAI-compatible API
MCP discovery by outcome
panels.description: `eddi_mcp_discovery_total`

panels.title: MCP conversation access denied
panels.description: `eddi_mcp_conversation_access_denied_total` — an MCP tool tried to reach a conversation it is not scoped to.

panels.title: Agent signing & verification
panels.description: `eddi_agent_identity_*` — A2A peer message signing. A non-zero verify-fail rate is a security signal, not a performance one.

panels.title: Nonce rejections
panels.description: `eddi_agent_nonce_*_rejected_total`. Clock-skew rejections usually mean unsynchronised peers rather than an attack; replay rejections do not.

panels.title: OpenAI-compatible requests
panels.description: `eddi_openai_requests_total` by `outcome` — the `/v1` adapter.

panels.title: OpenAI-compatible requests by mode
panels.description: …by `mode` (streaming vs blocking).

panels.title: Conversations and chat keys via /v1
panels.description: `eddi_openai_conversations_created_total` — each new chat maps to a fresh EDDI conversation; `eddi_openai_conversations_rolled_over_total` — conversations ended at `max-conversation-steps`; `eddi_openai_chat_keys_total` by `source` — where each stateful request's chat key came from (`history` = derived from the opening messages, `shared` = the single per-user conversation).

panels.title: A2A requests by outcome
panels.description: `eddi_a2a_requests_total` by `outcome` — `busy` is a refusal at `eddi.a2a.max-concurrent-requests`.

panels.title: A2A tasks by state
panels.description: `eddi_a2a_tasks_total` by `state` — `failed` and `input_required` are turns that did not produce an answer.

panels.title: A2A in-flight turns
panels.description: `eddi_a2a_in_flight` — A2A turns holding a slot; compare with `eddi.a2a.max-concurrent-requests`.

panels.title: Attachments
panels.description: `eddi_attachment_*_total` — multimodal attachment handling.

panels.title: Observe-mode decisions by reason
panels.description: `eddi_channel_observe_decisions_total` by `reason` — one sample per message a passive channel observer saw. `MATCHED` replied; `NO_TRIGGER` was not for it; `COOLDOWN` / `DAILY_RESPONSE_CAP` / `DAILY_COST_CAP` wanted to and were stopped. A rising throttle share against a flat `MATCHED` share is an observer whose triggers are too broad for its budget.

panels.title: Capability queries
panels.description: `eddi_capability_query_count_total` vs `eddi_capability_miss_count_total`.

panels.title: Capability misses (1h)
panels.description: eddi_capability_miss_count is untagged on purpose: the skill string is caller-supplied, so a per-skill label would be unbounded. The skills themselves are in the WARN log line 'No capability match'.

panels.title: Match strategy applied
panels.description: `eddi_capability_strategy_applied_total` by `strategy` — which matching strategy won.

panels.title: Connection resolution by outcome
panels.description: `eddi_connection_resolve_count_total`

panels.title: Connection resolve latency
panels.description: `eddi_connection_resolve_time_seconds`. The tag key is `authType` in source and stays camelCase in Prometheus — only dots become underscores.

targets.expr:
sum by (binding, authType) (rate(eddi_connection_resolve_time_seconds_sum{job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval]))
  / clamp_min(sum by (binding, authType) (rate(eddi_connection_resolve_time_seconds_count{job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9)

panels.title: Missing connection grants by binding
panels.description: `eddi_connection_grant_missing_count_total` — a binding asked for a grant that is not configured. This is a config gap, not a runtime error.

panels.title: Caller identity resolution by reference
panels.description: `eddi_caller_identity_resolution_total` by `reference` — `token` vs `userId`.

panels.title: Caller identity resolution
panels.description: `eddi_caller_identity_resolution_total` by `outcome` — `${caller:token}` / `${caller:userId}` resolution. Failures fail closed, so a rising failure rate means HTTP calls are being refused rather than sent unauthenticated.

panels.title: OAuth link flows started
panels.description: `eddi_connection_oauth_authorize_count_total` by `authType` — per-user account links begun via POST /connections/{name}/authorize.

panels.title: OAuth callback outcomes
panels.description: `eddi_connection_oauth_callback_count_total` by `outcome`. `binding_mismatch` is a valid state arriving without the nonce cookie that started the flow: a link followed in another browser, or a confused-deputy attempt.

panels.title: Token refresh outcomes
panels.description: `eddi_connection_token_refresh_count_total` by `outcome`. `invalid_grant` marks the grant dead (the user must reconnect); `transient` leaves it untouched for the next request to retry.

panels.title: Token refresh claim protocol
panels.description: `eddi_connection_token_refresh_claim_count_total` by `outcome`. A rising `lease_released` is a provider having a bad time (claimants giving the lease back without a token), not a bug; `lease_expired` means a claimant died or hung.

panels.title: Vault cache hits vs misses
panels.description: `eddi_vault_cache_{hits,misses}_total` in `SecretResolver`.

panels.title: Vault errors
panels.description: `eddi_vault_errors_count_total` (provider) and `eddi_vault_resolve_errors_total` (resolver). A resolve error means a `${vault:...}` reference did not resolve — the dependent HTTP call or model provider is now failing. `eddi_vault_reseal_failures_total` counts sealed rows (OAuth grants) a DEK rotation could not open and skipped — each is a linked account that may need reconnecting.

panels.title: Vault operations
panels.description: `eddi_vault_{resolve,store,delete,rotate}_count_total`.

panels.title: Vault latency (avg)
panels.description: Three distinct timers, not duplicates: `eddi_vault_resolve_time_seconds` is measured in `SecretResolver` (cache included), `eddi_vault_resolve_duration_seconds` in `VaultSecretProvider` (the backing store only). The gap between them is what the cache is saving you.

panels.title: Quota allowed vs denied
panels.description: `eddi_tenant_quota_allowed_total` counts slot acquisitions only — the read-only gates (`checkAgentQuota`, `checkCostBudget`) deliberately do not touch it, so treat this as acquisitions vs all denials rather than a strict ratio.

panels.title: Quota denials by type
panels.description:
`eddi_tenant_quota_denied_total` by `type` (conversation / api_call / agent / cost).

The `tenant!=""` filter is not redundant. Before the tag-key collision in `TenantQuotaService` was fixed, this counter was also registered untagged, and Prometheus keeps those old samples for its whole retention window after an upgrade. Without the filter that legacy series renders as a nameless extra row here for days. The aggregate panel deliberately omits the filter so it still counts them.

targets.expr: sum by (type) (rate(eddi_tenant_quota_denied_total{job=~"$job", tenant!=""}[$__rate_interval])) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Tenant cost metering by outcome
panels.description: `eddi_tenant_cost_metering_total` by `outcome`: how each settled turn or Dream run was charged against the tenant monthly cost budget. A non-zero `error` rate means a charge failed and was logged rather than thrown, so spend is being under-counted.

panels.title: Spend gate refusals (model calls; tool calls for tenant_check_error)
panels.description: `eddi_llm_spend_refused_total`, by reason: model calls refused before they were made because the tenant monthly budget or the agent `maxCostPerConversationUsd` ceiling was already reached (`tenant_budget`, `conversation_ceiling`) or the quota store could not answer (`tenant_accounting_unavailable`). `tenant_check_error` means the budget check itself threw — a defect that should never be non-zero — and counts refused model calls and refused tool calls alike.

panels.title: Quota denials by tenant (1h)
panels.description: Who is hitting their limits. Filtered to tagged series — see the by-type panel.

panels.title: Tenant usage rate
panels.description: `eddi_tenant_usage_{conversations,api_calls}_total` by `tenant`.

panels.title: Tenant spend rate
panels.description: `eddi_tenant_usage_cost_total` by `tenant`.

panels.title: Audit entries dropped
panels.description: `eddi_audit_entries_dropped_total` — the audit ledger shed an entry rather than grow the heap. Any sustained non-zero value is a compliance problem under the EU AI Act: the ledger is no longer a complete record. Alert on this.

panels.title: Audit chain positions allocated by another replica
panels.description: `eddi_audit_sequence_collisions_total` — the audit ledger found a chain position already stored that this node had not handed out, which means a second replica is allocating positions for the same conversation. Sequence allocation is a `MAX(sequence)` read rather than an atomic reservation, so this produces duplicate positions and `/auditstore/verify` grades those conversations BROKEN. Any non-zero value means the deployment is running multiple replicas without conversation affinity — fix the routing. It is a partial detector: two nodes handing out an identical range are only caught at verify time.

panels.title: Quota refusals caused by the store, not by a limit
panels.description: `eddi_tenant_quota_unavailable_total` by `type` — the quota store could not answer, so the turn was refused for safety without any limit being reached — a driver failure in whichever store is configured (`MongoException` in `MongoTenantQuotaStore`, the default backend, or `SQLException` in `PostgresTenantQuotaStore`). These used to be counted on `eddi_tenant_quota_denied_total` and answered 429 with `Retry-After: 60`, so a database outage looked exactly like a tenant burning through its allowance on the panels above. They now answer 503 `quota_accounting_unavailable`. Any sustained non-zero value here is an infrastructure problem, not a capacity decision — alert on it separately from the denial panels.

panels.title: Audit queue depth vs capacity
panels.description: Entries waiting to be written to the audit store. Entries are dropped (and counted on eddi_audit_entries_dropped_total) once the queue is full; alert EddiAuditQueueFilling fires at half.

panels.title: Gate verified
panels.description: 1 when every provisioned Platform Operator version last read back with a sound approval gate. 0 also before any report has arrived (fresh deployment, operator never activated). min, so one unverified replica reads 0. Alert EddiOperatorGateRegressed fires on a 1 -> 0 transition.

panels.title: Canary outcomes
panels.description: `eddi_operator_canary_total` by `outcome`.

panels.title: Gate last verified (this process)
panels.description: How long ago this EDDI process last received a verified gate report (eddi_operator_gate_last_verified_timestamp_seconds). Empty until one arrives after boot; EddiOperatorGateRegressed needs one before it can fire.

panels.title: Cluster events published vs consumed
panels.description: Cache-coherence events on the EVENTS stream (cluster mode only; 0 on a single node). The full picture is on the EDDI Cluster dashboard.

panels.title: Lease wait
panels.description: How long turns wait for their conversation lease (cluster mode only).

panels.title: Shared-state (KV) latency
panels.description: Mean JetStream KV call latency by bucket (cluster mode only).

panels.title: Fenced writes and lost leases
panels.description: Turns whose write the fence refused, and leases lost while a turn ran (cluster mode only). Both are dead-lettered.

panels.title: Export & import rate
panels.description: `eddi_backup_export_count_total` and `eddi_backup_import_count_total` — archive operations attempted.

panels.title: Export & import failures
panels.description: `eddi_backup_export_failure_count_total` and `eddi_backup_import_failure_count_total`. A rising import failure rate with a flat export rate usually means archives from another version.

panels.title: Upgrade / sync runs
panels.description: `eddi_backup_upgrade_count_total` and `eddi_backup_upgrade_failure_count_total` — one pair of increments per agent synced, whether from a ZIP or from a remote instance.

panels.title: Upgrade resource outcomes
panels.description: Per-resource outcome of a sync: `eddi_backup_upgrade_resource_updated_count_total`, `eddi_backup_upgrade_resource_created_count_total`, `eddi_backup_upgrade_resource_skipped_count_total`, `eddi_backup_upgrade_resource_failure_count_total`. All-skipped runs mean source and target already agree; a created line where an updated one is expected means the matcher is not joining.

panels.title: Segments stored by knowledge base
panels.description: `eddi_ingestion_segments_stored_total` — chunks embedded and written to a knowledge base by source ingestion, per `knowledgeBase` and `source`. Flat while a crawl runs means nothing changed.

targets.expr: sum by (knowledgeBase, source) (rate(eddi_ingestion_segments_stored_total{job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval])) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Ingestion errors by source
panels.description: `eddi_ingestion_errors_total` — pages that failed to fetch, convert or embed during source ingestion, per `knowledgeBase` and `source`.

targets.expr: sum by (knowledgeBase, source) (rate(eddi_ingestion_errors_total{job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval])) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Files accepted by upload source
panels.description: `eddi_ingestion_files_stored_total` — files accepted onto a source of type `upload`, per `source`. Storing a file does not index it; the source has to be run.

panels.title: Files refused by upload source
panels.description: `eddi_ingestion_files_rejected_total` — files an upload source turned away, per `source`. A climbing rate means operators are being refused; the reason is in the response (too large, unreadable format, or the source is at its limit).

panels.title: Files deleted from upload source
panels.description: `eddi_ingestion_files_deleted_total` — files removed from an upload source, per `source`. A delete also removes the chunks the file produced.

panels.title: Outbound requests by outcome
panels.description: `eddi_http_outbound_requests_total`

targets.expr: sum by (profile, outcome) (rate(eddi_http_outbound_requests_total{job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval])) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Outbound exchange time (mean)
panels.description: `eddi_http_outbound_duration_seconds` — mean over the interval

panels.title: Outbound requests refused by policy
panels.description: `eddi_http_outbound_blocked_total` — ssrf, cap, redirect

targets.expr: sum by (profile, reason) (rate(eddi_http_outbound_blocked_total{job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval])) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Outbound body bytes read
panels.description: `eddi_http_outbound_bytes_total`

panels.title: HTTP request rate by status
panels.description: Quarkus `http-server` binder. Unlike EDDI's own timers this one does publish buckets.

panels.title: HTTP latency (mean / peak)
panels.description: Mean and peak, not percentiles: http.server.requests publishes no histogram buckets. Buckets would multiply every series by ~70 for each of up to quarkus.micrometer.binder.http-server.max-uri-tags URI tags. The peak is Micrometer's decaying max, and long-lived streams (SSE) count as one long request.

panels.title: GC pause rate
panels.description: Seconds of GC pause per second. Above ~0.1 the JVM is spending 10% of wall clock collecting.

panels.title: Connection pools
panels.description: Only the active datastore's series exist: MongoDB pool listener or Agroal (quarkus.datasource.metrics.enabled).

targets.legendFormat: MongoDB mean wait for a connection (ms)

panels.title: Idempotent turn duplicates by outcome
panels.description: Rate of `eddi_turn_idempotency_total` by outcome: `replayed` (served from the stored turn), `waited` (answered when the running turn finished), `wait_timeout` (the wait budget ran out, caller sees 409).

panels.title: Inbound webhook events by outcome
panels.description: Rate of `eddi_webhook_events_total` by outcome: `accepted` (a turn was started), `duplicate` (200, already accepted), `in_progress` (409, first delivery still running), `refused_capacity` (503, the integration is over its `maxDeliveriesPerWindow` budget or the shared replay-protection cache is past its backstop) or `refused_<status>` (HTTP status returned: 400, 401 bad signature, unknown integration id or unusable secret, 403, 409 awaiting approval, 413, 415, 422, 429, 500, 503 agent not deployed or shutting down). A rising 401 rate is a misconfigured sender or a probe; a rising `refused_capacity` is one integration sending faster than its budget.

panels.title: Guardrail triggers by phase, type and action
panels.description: `eddi_guardrail_triggered_total` — input/output guardrails that fired on an LLM task, per `phase` (input/output), `type` and `action` (block/redact/reprompt/warn). Flat is normal when no guardrails are configured.

targets.expr: sum by (phase, type, action) (rate(eddi_guardrail_triggered_total{job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval])) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Classifier guardrail latency and outcome
panels.description: Mean `eddi_guardrail_classifier_duration_seconds` by `provider` and `outcome` (safe, unsafe, unparseable, unavailable, timeout). An input classifier runs before the main model and an output classifier screens its answer afterwards; only turns whose agent configures a classifier guardrail record samples. Empty ("no samples yet") when there is no classifier traffic, because a mean latency has no honest value without calls.

targets.expr: sum by (provider, outcome) (rate(eddi_guardrail_classifier_duration_seconds_sum{job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (provider, outcome) (rate(eddi_guardrail_classifier_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Judge guardrail latency and outcome
panels.description: Mean `eddi_guardrail_judge_duration_seconds` by `provider` and `outcome` (pass, fail, unparseable, unavailable, timeout). A judge grades an LLM task's answer against the issue codes its author declared, after the model answered; only turns whose agent configures a judge guardrail record samples. Watch `unparseable` and `unavailable`: under failMode open they switch the check off without blocking anything. Empty ("no samples yet") when there is no judge traffic, because a mean latency has no honest value without calls.

targets.expr: sum by (provider, outcome) (rate(eddi_guardrail_judge_duration_seconds_sum{job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (provider, outcome) (rate(eddi_guardrail_judge_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Ratings by kind and bucket
panels.description: `eddi_conversation_ratings_total` — ratings people gave, per `kind` (conversation/message) and `bucket` (low/neutral/high on the normalized score). A re-rating counts again; withdrawals (`eddi_conversation_ratings_withdrawn_total`) are query B. Flat is normal when no agent has `ratingConfig` enabled.

targets.expr: sum by (kind, bucket) (rate(eddi_conversation_ratings_total{job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval])) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Average normalized rating by agent
panels.description: Mean of `eddi_conversation_ratings_normalized` (0..1) per `agentId` over the window, from its `_sum` and `_count`.

title: E.D.D.I — Full Metrics Reference (2/2)
description: Every meter E.D.D.I registers with Micrometer, grouped by subsystem. Counters are shown as rates, timers as mean and peak from _seconds_sum/_seconds_count/_seconds_max. Only eddi_pipeline_task_duration publishes histogram buckets, so it is the only EDDI timer with true percentiles. Companion to the Operations Command Center dashboard.
